C1357.title: Earning Farm Reentrancy Attack Incident
C1357.summary: On August 9, 2023, the DeFi project Earning Farm suffered a reentrancy attack. The attacker exploited a reentrancy vulnerability in the smart contract, repeatedly calling a function before the contract state was updated, resulting in approximately $530,000 in asset losses.
